svg.title: An island around Zarathustra
svg.desc: One circular island. The gallery at its centre. Ocean all around. Built footprints and streets share the physical city coordinates. The city has regular gated honeycomb courts around its retained sixfold centre. Existing source houses, entrances and underground links share these exact map coordinates.

g.text: Honeycomb courts · real house entrances · dashed underground passages · homes on the night face
One circular island. The gallery at its centre. Ocean all around.
